title: spec(conversions): the stored pass does not list a dashboard whose globalFilters entry is keyed dateRange beside a declared dateRange (the #29213 refusal)
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSduNGC2SZXszyrNut

Filing gate: ② a follow-up the seat named in its ACCEPT on PR #29370 (comment 6580087029, item 5) before landing. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What happens

PR #29370 (merged as `c268b72b`, card #29213) refuses a dashboard that declares `dateRange` and also keys a `globalFilters` entry `dateRange` (by `name`, else `field`). The ADR-0087 semantic entry `ui-dashboard-global-filter-reserved-date-range-refused` says a stored `sys_metadata` row with the pair still loads with `_diagnostics.valid: false` and is refused on its next save. But `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` in `packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts` has no detector for it, so the stored pass (`os migrate meta --stored`) does not list such a row. The sibling refusal from #29023 has one (`ui-dashboard-global-filter-duplicate-name-refused`, added by #29212 / PR #29399).

## Done when

- A `RefusedStoredShape` with id `ui-dashboard-global-filter-reserved-date-range-refused` sits beside `dashboardDuplicateGlobalFilterName`, built on `reservedDateRangeGlobalFilters` from `packages/spec/src/ui/duplicate-global-filter-names.ts`, reporting at `globalFilters[i].name` (or `.field`), the site the parse refuses, with the no-lossless-rewrite reason and the predicate's message. `refused-shapes.test.ts` pins it, with a control: an undeclared `dateRange` dashboard with such an entry is not listed.
- The entry's `acceptanceCriteria` (`18.ui-dashboard-global-filter-reserved-date-range-refused.ts`) gains one sentence saying `os migrate meta --stored` lists such a row. The duplicate-name entry (#29023 D3) gains the same sentence.

Serial: same file as any other open `refused-shapes.ts` card.

Related: #29213 / PR #29370, #29212 / PR #29399, #29023.
